Messages.Author: Daz
Messages.Body:
I did a search for Disease on google and this was what I found:

"Disease reduces the minion's hand damage by 2.
(Typically leaving a vampire with -1 hand damage).

Superior Buring Wrath adds two damage to the minion's hand damage,
and this added damage is aggravated.

So, that's a total of 1 damage, of which the last 2 are aggravated.

I see the problem now.

But, stated as above, it seems clear that this situation yields a
strike that does 1 aggravated damage.

So let it be so, until the RT says otherwise (*).

(An inferior BW used by a vampire who is the victim of a superior
Disease would result in zero damage.)

--
L. Scott Johnson (vte...@wizards.com)
Official VtES Net.Rep for Wizards of the Coast.
(*) - Subject to review by Rules Team"

Is this correct? Does a minion with -1 strength have to strike for at
least strength+2 to do damage?

Messages.Author: LSJ
Messages.Body:
Daz wrote:
> Does a minion with -1 strength have to strike for at
> least strength+2 to do damage?

If he wishes to strike with a strike that does damage based on strength, yes.
If integer X is less than 2, then -1 + X <= 0

He is free to use a Saturday Night Special to do damage, for instance, though.
